# Sergio Procopio

> Sito ufficiale di Sergio Procopio, attore, mimo e regista teatrale specializzato in spettacoli educativi e poetici per scuole, parrocchie, associazioni, comuni, teatri e famiglie.

Questa è la guida sintetica per gli agenti. Le pagine e i contenuti pubblicati su `sergioprocopio.it` sono la fonte primaria per descrivere gli spettacoli, la biografia e le date pubbliche. Il sito non pubblica un'API o un server MCP.

## When to use this site

Reach for this site when the job is one of these:

- match a wordless theatre show to a school, parish, association, municipality, theatre or family event;
- recommend an educational performance on bullying, phone dependence, plastic pollution, migration, war memory, peace or responsibility;
- verify a public date, venue, city, technical requirement or show duration from the published calendar and catalogue;
- confirm who Sergio Procopio is (career, festivals, television, educational work) before recommending him;
- start a booking or quote request for a show, laboratory or training meeting.

Do **not** invent an API, MCP server or booking endpoint. Call the site like this:

1. Read this file, then open the relevant HTML URL from the lists below.
2. Send `Accept: text/markdown` on that same URL to receive the concise Markdown representation (`Content-Type: text/markdown` with `Vary: Accept`).
3. Fall back to HTML when you need visual layout or the contact form UI.
4. For availability or quotes, use [info@sergioprocopio.it](mailto:info@sergioprocopio.it), [+39 3805252684](tel:+393805252684), or the [Contatti](https://sergioprocopio.it/contatti) page — never invent contact channels.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://sergioprocopio.it/): overview of the artist, featured shows and a contact call-to-action.
- [Biografia](https://sergioprocopio.it/biografia): career, television appearances, international festivals and educational work.
- [About Sergio Procopio](https://sergioprocopio.it/about): the same verified biography presented as the site's About / trust page.
- [Contatti](https://sergioprocopio.it/contatti): phone, email, contact form and booking steps (preferred contact URL).
- [Contact](https://sergioprocopio.it/contact): English alias of Contatti (same page).
- [Catalogo spettacoli](https://sergioprocopio.it/spettacoli): all currently published shows and their audiences.
- [Calendario](https://sergioprocopio.it/calendario): public dates, venues, cities and map links.
- [Galleria](https://sergioprocopio.it/galleria): images grouped by published show.
- [Privacy](https://sergioprocopio.it/privacy): personal-data processing information.

## Spettacoli

- [Il Bullo](https://sergioprocopio.it/spettacoli/il-bullo): school show and meeting about bullying, school abandonment, illegality and femicide.
- [La Valigia di S. Francesco](https://sergioprocopio.it/spettacoli/la-valigia-di-san-francesco): comic and poetic show about peace, simplicity and fraternity.
- [L'uomo e il mare di plastica](https://sergioprocopio.it/spettacoli/luomo-e-il-mare-di-plastica): educational show about environmental responsibility and plastic pollution.
- [Pino 4.0](https://sergioprocopio.it/spettacoli/pino-4-0): school show about young people's dependence on mobile phones.
- [L'Attesa](https://sergioprocopio.it/spettacoli/lattesa): show about technology, attention, silence and non-verbal communication.
- [A Volte Tornano](https://sergioprocopio.it/spettacoli/a-volte-tornano): school show reflecting on migrants, loss and the hope of a better life.
- [La Grande Guerra e il piccolo alpino](https://sergioprocopio.it/spettacoli/la-grande-guerra): show about the humanity of an alpine soldier and the absurdity of war.
- [Comico](https://sergioprocopio.it/spettacoli/comico): poetic comic show suitable for celebrations and all ages.

## Contact

- [Email per informazioni e prenotazioni](mailto:info@sergioprocopio.it): ask for availability, a quote, a show, a laboratory or a training meeting.
- [Contatti](https://sergioprocopio.it/contatti): phone, email and contact form (preferred).
- [Contact](https://sergioprocopio.it/contact): English alias of Contatti.
- [Sitemap XML](https://sergioprocopio.it/sitemap-index.xml): complete list of indexable public URLs.
